name: remote-ssh
description: Connect a Claude Code session to remote machines over SSH: persistent connections, sshfs mounts, remote project memory and messaging with remote sessions.

messaging.title: Messaging
messaging.description: Register this session on connected hosts and relay messages between sessions.

poll_interval_s.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_interval_s.description: Period of the connection health check and the message relay.

sshfs_options.title: Extra sshfs options
sshfs_options.description: Comma-separated options appended with -o to every sshfs mount, for example cache=yes,compression=no.

redirect_confirm.title: Confirm redirected Bash
redirect_confirm.description: Ask for approval of the rewritten ssh command line on every Bash call redirected to a remote host.
